poll.q: Aaj ki sab se bari khabar kaun si hai — Claude Fable 5.2 ka Fermat theorem, OpenAI ka $10bn quarter, ya Kohat mein 10 police shaheed?
options: 🧠 Fable 5.2 — Fermat ka theorem 30 ghanton mein
💰 OpenAI ka $10bn quarter — lekin loss bhi $10.9bn

https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-a.what: Anthropic ne Claude Fable 5.2 launch kiya — $8/$40 per million tokens, 30% tez output, 1M context. 1,000 agents ne Fermat's Last Theorem ko 30 ghanton mein formalize kar diya; FrontierSWE v2 par 69.9% aur real freelance tasks par 41.3%. Mythos wohi model hai, safeguards ke baghair, sirf verified organisations ke liye.
https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-a.why: AI ab sirf code likh nahi raha — maths ke theorem prove kar raha hai, hardware design kar raha hai, aur Anthropic ke apne codebase ka 90%+ khud likh raha hai. Frontier models ki race ab 'kaun zyada smart' se 'kaun zyada kaam kar sakta hai' par aa gayi hai.
https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-a.next: Dekhna ye hai ke Fable 5.2 real developers ke haath mein kaisa perform karta hai — Anthropic ke apne benchmarks hamesha achhe lagte hain. Aur Mythos ka verification wall: kya ye safety ka waqai tareeqa hai ya sirf aik nayi gatekeeping?
https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-a.take: Meri take: Fermat 30 ghanton mein — ye number sun kar lagta hai AI ne maths ki duniya mein waqai kuch kar dikhaya. Lekin yaad rakho, ye benchmarks Anthropic ke apne hain, aur '90% codebase Claude likhta hai' ka matlab ye nahi ke engineers bekar ho gaye — un ka kaam ab review aur direction hai. Model sasta hua hai, achha hai — lekin jo cheez free nahi hui, wo hai sochna.

https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/11/openai.what: OpenAI ki quarterly revenue pehli dafa $10 billion paar kar gayi — Q2 se taqreeban 50% izafa, annual run rate $50 billion. Lekin operating loss bhi $10.9 billion tak barh gaya. Anthropic is se aage hai: us ki Q3 revenue $17 billion aur run rate $81 billion batayi ja rahi hai.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/11/openai.why: AI companies ki race ab revenue ki race ban gayi hai — $10 billion aik quarter mein, ye software ki tareekh mein pehle kabhi nahi hua. Lekin loss bhi utna hi bara hai: har dollar kamane ke liye aik dollar se zyada kharch ho raha hai.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/11/openai.next: Anthropic ka IPO 18-19 November ko hai — us ki pricing batayegi ke market is race ko kitna serious leti hai. Aur OpenAI ka $1.25 trillion valuation wala funding round bhi chal raha hai.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/11/openai.take: Meri take: $10bn revenue aur $10.9bn loss — aik saath. Ye kahani hai AI economy ki: paisa aa raha hai, lekin us se zyada ja raha hai. Jo company pehle ye gap band karegi, wo jeetegi. Abhi tak koi nahi jeeta — sab sirf tez bhaag rahe hain.

https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-ember.what: Meta ne Muse Ember launch kiya — sab se chhota aur efficient Muse model, $0.10 input / $0.50 output per million tokens, 1M context, 512K output. Artificial Analysis par score 36, Claude Haiku 5.5 ke barabar, lekin cost per task aik tihai ($0.14 vs $0.41). Meta Model API aur Muse Code par live hai.
https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-ember.why: Frontier models ki khabarain to roz aati hain, lekin asal paisa chhote models mein hai — jo agents roz lakhon dafa chalayenge. Ember ka matlab hai: AI ab har product mein ghus sakta hai bina bill phatay.
https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-ember.next: Dekhna ye hai ke developers Ember ko Haiku ki jagah waqai istemal karte hain ya nahi — aur kya Meta is price par tik sakta hai ya ye sirf market share khareedne ki koshish hai.
https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-ember.take: Meri take: Haiku jitna smart, aik tihai keemat — ye woh headline hai jo har developer ko ruk kar sochne par majboor karti hai. Lekin yaad rakho: Ember knowledge mein kamzor hai, 64% sawalon par jawab dene se inkar kar deta hai. Sasta model achha hai — jab tak tumhein pata ho ke wo kya nahi kar sakta.

https://www.unite.ai/elevenlabs-unveils-.what: ElevenLabs ne New York Summit mein 13 products ka package dikhaya — businesses apne data se models fine-tune karwa sakenge, ElevenAgents mein Memory aur Routines aayengi, aur naya ElevenAI app meetings sun kar notes aur action items banayega. NVIDIA ke saath partnership bhi barhi: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL aur 15 MW Vera Rubin compute.
https://www.unite.ai/elevenlabs-unveils-.why: Voice AI ab sirf 'awaz banana' nahi raha — ye poora kaam karne wala teammate ban raha hai. ElevenLabs samajh gaya hai ke sirf achhi awaz se company nahi banti, enterprise contracts se banti hai.
https://www.unite.ai/elevenlabs-unveils-.next: Customization 'aane wale mahinon mein' shuru hogi — abhi ye roadmap hai, product nahi. Asal test ye hai ke kitni companies waqai apna data de kar models train karwati hain.
https://www.unite.ai/elevenlabs-unveils-.take: Meri take: ElevenLabs ki awaz to hum sab ne suni hai — ab wo hamari meetings bhi sunna chahta hai. ElevenAI ka idea achha hai, lekin 'consent ke saath' wali baat par nazar rakhni hogi. Aur ek sawaal: kya har meeting ki recording banana waqai productivity hai, ya sirf aik aur tareeqa hai kaam ko record karne ka?

https://gulfnews.com/business/markets/co.what: CoreWeave ki Q3 revenue $3.66 billion ho gayi — 168% izafa, estimate se upar. 2026 ka forecast $13–13.3 billion kar diya, backlog $132.5 billion. Shares 7% upar gaye. Lekin net loss $709 million, qarz taqreeban $47 billion, aur capex $37–39 billion.
https://gulfnews.com/business/markets/co.why: AI infrastructure ki demand par sab se bara sawal tha: kya ye bubble hai? CoreWeave ke numbers kehte hain demand asal hai — customers $132 billion ke contracts sign kar chuke hain. Lekin qarz bhi asal hai.
https://gulfnews.com/business/markets/co.next: Dekhna ye hai ke CoreWeave qarz chuka kar kab munafa kamata hai — management kehta hai 2028 ki pehli half mein adjusted profit. Tab tak har quarter mein yehi sawal hoga: demand ya debt?
https://gulfnews.com/business/markets/co.take: Meri take: $132bn backlog aur $47bn qarz — aik hi company mein dono. Ye AI boom ki asal tasveer hai: demand itni zyada hai ke companies qarz le kar data centers bana rahi hain. Agar demand tik gayi to ye genius hai; agar nahi, to ye 2000 ka dot-com wala scene dobara hai. Abhi ke liye, bulls jeet rahe hain.

https://asia.nikkei.com/politics/interna.what: Teen Republican House chairs ne Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang ko 18 November ki closed-door briefing ke liye bulaya — Megaspeed executive Alice Huang se un ke rabtay aur Nvidia ke anti-espionage protocols par. US intel ke mutabiq Alice Huang Beijing ko maloomat de rahi thi. 11 November ki deadline tak Huang ne jawab nahi diya tha; chairman ne subpoena ki dhamki di hai. Nvidia ka board apni investigation bhi chala raha hai.
https://asia.nikkei.com/politics/interna.why: Ye sirf aik CEO ki kahani nahi — ye US-China chip war ka naya front hai. Agar chips China tak pohanch rahe hain to export controls ka kya faida? Aur agar duniya ki sab se qeemti chip company ka CEO jasoosi ke ilzaam mein phansa hai to poori industry hil jati hai.
https://asia.nikkei.com/politics/interna.next: 17 November ko Nvidia ki earnings call hai, 18 ko briefing. Dekhna ye hai ke Huang aata hai ya subpoena aata hai — aur board ki investigation kya nikalti hai. Abhi tak kisi par kuch sabit nahi hua.
https://asia.nikkei.com/politics/interna.take: Meri take: Ilzaam bara hai, saboot abhi public nahi. Lekin ye baat yaad rakho: jab Congress aik CEO ko bulati hai to ye sirf us ki kahani nahi hoti — ye poori industry ko message hota hai. Nvidia ke liye asal khatra subpoena nahi, ye hai ke agar chips ka rasta China tak waqai khula hai to export controls aur sakht honge — aur wo sab ko mehnga parega.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2043793.what: Kohat mein police party par hamle mein 10 ahalkar shaheed ho gaye, jin mein DSP Haidar Zaman aur Sub-Inspector Mukhtiar shamil hain; 12 zakhmi hue. Team ghair-qanooni gold mining ke khilaf operation se wapas aa rahi thi jab Fitna al-Khawarij ne hamla kiya; jawab mein 18 hamla-awar halak hue. TTP ne zimmedari qabool ki.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043793.why: Ye hamla batata hai ke dehshatgardi ab sirf sarhadon par nahi — ye criminal mafias ke saath mil kar mulk ke andar resources par qabza kar rahi hai. Gold mining ka qanoon aur security ka masla ab aik hi ho gaya hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043793.next: KP mein governor's rule aur emergency ke aik mahine baad bhi hamle jaari hain. Dekhna ye hai ke faceless courts aur Rs70bn security plan ka elaan kab amal mein badalta hai — aur illegal mining ke khilaf crackdown kitna sakht hota hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043793.take: Meri take: 10 shaheedein — aur un mein se aik DSP. Ye sirf aik khabar nahi, aik qurbani hai. Lekin sawal ye hai: har hamle ke baad hum 'qurbaniyon ko yaad rakhenge' kehte hain, phir agla hamla aa jata hai. Gold mafia aur dehshatgardon ka nexus todna hoga, warna ye silsila rukne wala nahi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2043746/pm-she.what: PM Shehbaz ne COP31 par kaha ke Pakistan ne 2 saalon mein taqreeban 22GW rooftop solar laga liya — 'aam shehriyon ka khamosh inqilab'. Pakistan ko 2035 tak low-carbon power ke liye $138bn aur koyla badalne ke liye mazeed $50bn chahiye. Clean sources ab energy mix ka 55% hain; Chashma-5 se 1,200MW milega.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043746/pm-she.why: Pakistan ne solar mein jo kiya, wo duniya mein kisi ne nahi kiya — bina subsidy, bina plan, sirf mehngi bijli se tang aa kar logon ne khud panels laga liye. Ye hukoomat ki kamyabi nahi, awaam ki majboori ki kamyabi hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043746/pm-she.next: COP31 par asal sawal finance ka hai — kya ameer mulk $188bn denge? Aur ghar par sawal ye hai ke grid itna solar sambhal sakta hai ya nahi. Dono ke jawab abhi nahi mile.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043746/pm-she.take: Meri take: 22GW — ye number waqai hairan-kun hai, lekin ye bhi yaad rakho ke ye figure PM ki apni hai, independently verify nahi hui. Aur solar lagana aik baat hai, us ko grid mein sambhalna doosri. Phir bhi, aik baat pakki hai: Pakistani awaam ne dikha diya ke jab system fail ho to wo khud hal nikal lete hain.

https://dunyanews.tv/en/Sports/982377-in.what: India ne Maldives ko 1-0 se hara kar Pakistan ko SAFF Championship ke semi-final mein pohancha diya. Suhail Bhat ne 38th minute mein penalty se goal kiya. Pakistan group B mein 3 points ke saath doosre number par raha. Semi-final 14 November ko Group A winner (Bangladesh ya Sri Lanka) se hoga; final 17 November ko.
https://dunyanews.tv/en/Sports/982377-in.why: Pakistan football ke liye ye bari baat hai — India se 3-2 ki haar ke baad bhi team ne semi-final tak ka rasta banaya. Football mein Pakistan ka naam ab sirf 'hissa lene wala' nahi raha.
https://dunyanews.tv/en/Sports/982377-in.next: 14 November ko semi-final — opponent Bangladesh ya Sri Lanka, dono hi tough hain. Jeet gaye to final mein India se dobara muqabla ho sakta hai, aur wo match poora mulk dekhega.
https://dunyanews.tv/en/Sports/982377-in.take: Meri take: Semi-final mein pohanchna achha hai, lekin ye bhi sach hai ke hum doosron ke match ke natijay par pohanchay hain — apni jeet se nahi. Ab semi-final mein apni taqat dikhani hogi. Football mein kismat aik dafa saath deti hai, doosri dafa mehnat chahiye hoti hai.

https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639763/psx.what: KSE-100 ne budh ko intraday 180,769 tak ja kar 180,000 ki satah paar ki — 18 August ke baad pehli dafa — lekin profit-taking ne gains mita diye aur index 251 points gir kar 179,084 par band hua. Is se pehle mangal ko 5,449 points ki rally hui thi. Cement stocks mein tezi rahi; volume 1.24 billion shares.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639763/psx.why: Market 180k paar kar ke wapas aana batata hai ke investor confidence wapas aa raha hai — remittances $3.9bn aur oil prices mein kami ne mood banaya. Lekin 180k aik psychological wall hai, aur har wall ko todne ke liye aik se zyada koshish lagti hai.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639763/psx.next: Dekhna ye hai ke index 180k ko dobara paar kar ke tikta hai ya phir consolidation hoti hai. US CPI aur MSCI review bhi agle dinon mein hain — dono market ko hila sakte hain.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639763/psx.take: Meri take: 180,000 paar karna khabar hai, wapas girna bhi khabar hai — dono aik saath. Market aise hi chalti hai: aik din josh, agle din profit-booking. Jo log sirf aik din ki rally dekh kar khush hote hain, wo aksar agle din pareshan hote hain. Lambi race mein ye sirf aik kadam hai.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2043674.what: PMD ne 12 se 14 November tak mulk ke balai hissay mein barish, aandhi aur paharon par barf-bari ki peshgoi ki hai. KP, Punjab, Islamabad, AJK aur GB mein tez barish aur ole bhi mumkin hain; din ka darja-e-hararat 2–4 degree girega. Sindh aur Balochistan mein mausam khushk rahega.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043674.why: November ki barish achhi khabar bhi hai aur mushkil bhi — smog mein kami aayegi, lekin pahari ilaqon mein safar mushkil hoga aur fasalon ko nuqsan bhi ho sakta hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043674.next: Spell 14 November ki subah tak rahega, phir maidani ilaqon mein dhund par sakti hai. Lahore ki smog par is ka asar dekhna dilchasp hoga — kya barish hawa saaf karti hai ya sirf aik waqti araam hai?
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043674.take: Meri take: Barish aayi to Lahore ki AQI 600 wali khabar thodi peeche jayegi — lekin ye hal nahi, sirf aik break hai. Smog ka asal hal barish nahi, policy hai. Phir bhi, is haftay chhat par chai peene ka mausam ban raha hai — enjoy karo.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2043866.what: Senate Chairman Yousaf Raza Gillani ne student unions ki bahali aur mazboot local government ka mutalba kiya. UNICEF ke workshop mein unhon ne kaha ke grassroots par leadership ki nurseries 'so gayi hain'. Unhon ne apni misaal di — local level se wazir-e-azam tak — aur kaha ke har rupee ka hisab hona chahiye.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043866.why: Student unions 1984 se banned hain — 40 saal se zyada ho gaye. Is ka natija ye hai ke siyasat mein naye chehre sirf khandani naam se aate hain, campus se nahi. Leadership ka pipeline hi band hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043866.next: Ye mutalba pehli dafa nahi hua — har saal koi na koi kehta hai, phir kuch nahi hota. Dekhna ye hai ke is dafa Senate se koi bill ya resolution nikalta hai ya ye bhi sirf aik taqreer ban kar reh jata hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043866.take: Meri take: Gillani sahab ne theek kaha — leadership nurseries se aati hai, aur hamari nurseries 40 saal se band hain. Lekin ye bhi sach hai ke jo log ab taqat mein hain, unhein is system se faida hai. Student unions ki bahali ka matlab hai naye logon ko jagah dena — aur ye faisla unhi ko karna hai jin ki jagah khatre mein par jayegi.

mood: 🧠 AI ki race tez, 💰 paisa barh raha hai, 🇵🇰 Kohat mein dukh — aaj khabrein halki nahi hain.
